{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the exact string values in 'revenue'
print("Unique values in 'revenue':")
print(df['revenue'].unique())

# Check the exact count of '999999.99'
count_exact = (df['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum()
print(f"\nNumber of rows with revenue == '999999.99': {count_exact}")

# Check if there are any variations like '999,999.99'
print(f"\nAny rows with '999,999.99'? {('999,999.99' in df['revenue'].values)}")

# Check the value counts
print(f"\nValue counts of 'revenue':")
print(df['revenue'].value_counts().head(10))"}
